random_method: single random.Random(seed).randrange(3); seed from secrets.randbits(64); no repeat

concepts.concept: A breakfast table becomes a solemn inspection bench: one diner holds a meal tray level while a second person checks a single rice mound with a small ruler, delaying two waiting diners.
concepts.strength: Common meal and rigid hierarchy become visible through one connected tool-to-food relation.
concepts.risk: The small ruler and exact point of contact could be too small; keep them near the front plane and reduce cast.

concepts.concept: In a shared bunk room, a woman presents a folded towel on both palms while a second person presses a small approval stamp onto a paper checklist and the other residents wait with towels.
concepts.strength: The everyday object and disproportionate ceremony can be read together.
concepts.risk: A paper approval mark cannot prove why the towel matters; avoid reliance on readable text.

concepts.concept: At a canteen table, a woman solemnly receives one polished eating spoon across a raised tray while another diner salutes the spoon and an untouched meal waits directly below.
concepts.strength: The elevated spoon and ordinary meal make the disproportion visible.
concepts.risk: A salute alone may read as a normal greeting unless gaze and shared spoon target are unmistakable.

coordinator_direction: ordinary shared barracks life or mealtime with an absurd ritual; authorial test axis, not requester lock
